Vanessa / Redwood Ops team,

We're seeing a ~60% drop in token throughput and sustained 5xx spikes from us-west2 starting ~08:45PT. This is directly impacting payment authorizations — multiple customers are failing checkout.

- Can you steer our traffic away from us-west2 to an adjacent region (us-west1 or us-central1) until the underlying cause is resolved?
- ETA for reroute and expected impact on session continuity / prompt cache?

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the attachment. We've pulled the metrics and can reproduce the 5xx spike and latency increase. I'm escalating now.

Immediate plan (proposed):
1) Enable cross-region priority routing for BlueGlacier to prefer us-west1 and us-central1 within 15-25m. This will route new requests away; existing sessions may see token-level retries while KV cache warms.
2) Spin ephemeral burst capacity in us-west1 to reduce cold-start tail latency (costly but required for immediate mitigation).
3) Ops to monitor KV hits and tail latency; keep you updated every 10 minutes.

Hannah — can you confirm sequencing and expected timeline for cache warm-up plus any known side-effects (session pinning, cookie affinity)?

I'll loop in Sean for the contract/credit discussion and Rishi for account exec escalation.

- Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa / Elena — quick technical update from SRE:
- Root-cause triage in progress: initial signs point to an autoscaler mis-signal + degraded NVMe IO on one control plane shard in us-west2 causing queuing and downstream 5xx.
- Short-term mitigation we can apply immediately: enable region preference policy for BlueGlacier (priority routing) + open an expedited ephemeral pool in us-west1 (estimated 10-20 GPU nodes).
- KV cache behavior: cold start expected; we estimate 3-7 minutes for warm-up to reach ~80% hit rate for commonly used prefixes. Expect elevated tail latency for sessions that are pinned to existing connections — recommend instructing client to retry idempotent requests.
- Risk: small percentage of requests may see duplicate token generation during retry windows; we will apply dedup heuristics where possible.

I'll kick off the routing change now after Sean confirms go-ahead for possible cost impact. I'll attach the warmup log once the pool starts.

Hannah Schmitt
Principal SRE, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
